subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Volkswagen Dieselgate
description: A fast breakdown of Volkswagen Dieselgate for builders.

hook.text: Volkswagen installed software to cheat emissions tests. 11 million cars produced more pollution than reported.

buildup.text: VW's governance structure concentrated power in a few insiders. Dissent was not tolerated.

discovery.text: Engineers built the cheat device under extreme pressure to meet impossible targets set by leadership.

twist.text: The supervisory board, which should have caught this, was dominated by labor reps and the founding family.

climax.text: Dieselgate cost VW over $30 billion in fines. A culture of fear replaced governance.

punchline.text: 11 million cars. $30 billion in fines. Governance by fear.

quiz.question: What enabled Volkswagen's emissions cheating?
options: A governance structure that concentrated power and silenced dissent
